question: Combien de clients au total ?
sql_reference: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM voicebank.clients

question: Nombre de clients par banque
sql_reference: SELECT banque, COUNT(*) FROM voicebank.clients GROUP BY banque

question: Clients par ville
sql_reference: SELECT ville_compte, COUNT(*) FROM voicebank.clients GROUP BY ville_compte

question: Top 10 clients par solde
sql_reference: SELECT id_client, solde_fcfa FROM voicebank.clients ORDER BY solde_fcfa DESC LIMIT 10
